the riddle of eyes: “Our eyes are our allies, yet oft do they betray, for eyes tell lies, so I advise, and thence do lead astray. Yet how will your eyes advise you?
the riddle of madness: "Love is as twin to madness, they say. They are bound fast as night is to day. So bring forth your most beloved one to me, that I might gauge the depth of your insanity."
the riddle of wisdom: "The parent knows the child, yet the reverse is far from true. The child knows not the parent: such is the parent's due. I am a lost child; for kinship do I yearn. So bring to me my "Parent".
the riddle of conviction: "Life is an enigma – a lender of mortal debt. Yet lighter pack makes fleeter foot and challenge nimbly met. So grant to me what you most prize, and thence elude your pondrous demise."
the riddle of rumination: "It's ever the first we keep fond in our breast, and ever the first that eclipses the rest. You know of the Seeker's Tokens, I trust? Those keepsakes of a fondly remembered journey?
answer the sphinx s riddles: NOTE : You're only given 1 try to answer per riddle. If you give the Sphinx a wrong answer, it will lock you out from earning the trophy from that playthrough and the Sphinx will abandon your game.
